verses.sloka: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ।हृष्ट रोमा महातेजाः शताअनन्दो महातपाः ॥१-५१-१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ।hṛṣṭa romā mahātejāḥ śatāanando mahātapāḥ ॥1-51-1॥

translations.english: Satananda the eldest son of Gautama, a great sage who looked brilliant with the power of austerities was thrilled to hear the words of Viswamitra the intellectual and experienced great astonishment on beholding Rama.
translations.hindi: गौतम ऋषि के शाप से नपुंसकत्व को प्राप्त हुए एवं उदास मन इन्द्र, अग्नि आदि देवताओं, सिद्धां, गन्धर्वो और चारणो से बोले

verses.sloka: गौतमस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठः तपसा द्योतित प्रभः ।राम संदर्शनात् एव परम् विस्मयम् आगतः ॥१-५१-२॥
verses.transliteration: gautamasya suto jyeṣṭhaḥ tapasā dyotita prabhaḥ ।rāma saṁdarśanāt eva param vismayam āgataḥ ॥1-51-2॥

translations.english: Satananda the eldest son of Gautama, a great sage who looked brilliant with the power of austerities was thrilled to hear the words of Viswamitra the intellectual and experienced great astonishment on beholding Rama.

verses.sloka: एतौ निषण्णौ संप्रेक्ष्य सुख आसीनौ नृपात्मजौ ।शताअनंदो मुनिश्रेष्ठम् विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-५१-३॥
verses.transliteration: etau niṣaṇṇau saṁprekṣya sukha āsīnau nṛpātmajau ।śatāanaṁdo muniśreṣṭham viśvāmitram atha abravīt ॥1-51-3॥

translations.english: Satananda saw the two princes comfortably seated nearby and said to Viswamitra, the foremost of the ascetics:
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी- इन्द्र के इस कथन को मिथ्या न समझना चाहिए | क्योकि सचमुच बात यही थी । गौतम ने सर्वदेवता का स्थान लेने के लिए तप किया था। क्रोधादि दुव त्तियों का प्रादुर्भाव होने से तपस्वी की तपस्या नष्ट हो जाती है। अतः इन्द्र ने महर्षि गौतम की तपस्या नष्टभ्रष्ट करने के लिए ही उनक्रो क्रुद्ध करने के ्रभि्राय से अहल्या के साथ भोग किया था; नहीं तो स्वर्ग में ग्रहल्या से कहीं अधिक सुन्दरी ह्वियों का ग्रमाव नहीं था । मृत्युलोकवासियों के सदनुष्ठानों में देवता अपने स्वार्थ के लिए सदा वित्न करते चले आए हैं । ] अफलोऽस्मि कृतस्तेन क्रोधात्‌ सा च निराळृता । शापमोचेण महता तपोस्यापहृतं मया

verses.sloka: अपि ते मुनि शार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी ।दर्शिता राज पुत्राय तपो दीर्घम् उपागता ॥१-५१-४॥
verses.transliteration: api te muni śārdūla mama mātā yaśasvinī ।darśitā rāja putrāya tapo dīrgham upāgatā ॥1-51-4॥

translations.english: "O Tiger among ascetics, was my renowned mother who had been practising intense austerities for long shown to the prince (Rama)?

verses.sloka: अपि रामे महातेजो मम माता यशस्विनी ।वन्यैः उपाहरत् पूजाम् पूजा अर्हे सर्व देहिनाम् ॥१-५१-५॥
verses.transliteration: api rāme mahātejo mama mātā yaśasvinī ।vanyaiḥ upāharat pūjām pūjā arhe sarva dehinām ॥1-51-5॥

translations.english: Did my highly lustrous and celebrated mother offer homage to Rama, worthy of reverence by all living beings, with things available in the forest?
translations.hindi: ब के इन वाक्यों को सुन, अग्नि को आगे कर पवनादि देबवागण, कव्यवाहूनादि पितरों के पास जाकर बोले

verses.sloka: अपि रामाय कथितम् यथा वृत्तम् पुरातनम् ।मम मातुः महातेजो दैवेन दुरनुष्ठितम् ॥१-५१-६॥
verses.transliteration: api rāmāya kathitam yathā vṛttam purātanam ।mama mātuḥ mahātejo daivena duranuṣṭhitam ॥1-51-6॥

translations.english: O highly powerful sage, was Rama told the old story about the misdeed of god (Indra) to my mother?
translations.hindi: इन्द्र बृषण-रहित हो गए हैं और तुम्हारे इस मेढे के अण्ड- कोश है, अतएव इसके अण्डकोष उखाड़ कर, इन्द्र को तुरन्त दे दीजिए

verses.sloka: अपि कौशिक भद्रम् ते गुरुणा मम संगता ।माता मम मुनिश्रेष्ठ राम संदर्शनात् इतः ॥१-५१-७॥
verses.transliteration: api kauśika bhadram te guruṇā mama saṁgatā ।mātā mama muniśreṣṭha rāma saṁdarśanāt itaḥ ॥1-51-7॥

translations.english: O Son of Kushika (Viswamitra) be blessed. O the best among the ascetics, as a result of beholding Rama, was my mother united with my father?

verses.sloka: अपि मे गुरुणा रामः पूजितः कुशिकात्मज ।इह आगतो महातेजाः पूजाम् प्राप्य महात्मनः ॥१-५१-८॥
verses.transliteration: api me guruṇā rāmaḥ pūjitaḥ kuśikātmaja ।iha āgato mahātejāḥ pūjām prāpya mahātmanaḥ ॥1-51-8॥

translations.english: O Son of Kushika was Rama honoured by my father? Was my most brilliant father honoured by illustrious Rama when he arrived?

verses.sloka: अपि शांतेन मनसा गुरुः मे कुशिकात्मज ।इह आगतेन रामेण पूजितेन अभिवादितः ॥१-५१-९॥
verses.transliteration: api śāṁtena manasā guruḥ me kuśikātmaja ।iha āgatena rāmeṇa pūjitena abhivāditaḥ ॥1-51-9॥

translations.english: O Kushika's son did pious Rama welcome my father with a tranquil mind when he arrived?"
translations.hindi: i उनको चू कर, गोतम ऋषि के आश्रम में प्रवेश किया

verses.sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।प्रति उवाच शतानंदम् वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कोविदम् ॥१-५१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।prati uvāca śatānaṁdam vākyajño vākya kovidam ॥1-51-10॥

translations.english: Great sage Viswamitra equipped with the knowledge of words heard Satananda who was proficient in speech. And replied:
translations.hindi: यज्ञ में अंडकोष-रहित मेढे लेने लगे । SE हे राघव ! मेढे के अंडकोष निकाल कर, इन्द्र के लगा दिए है.

verses.sloka: न अतिक्रान्तम् मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत् कर्तव्यम् कृतम् मया ।संगता मुनिना पत्नी भार्गवेण इव रेणुका ॥१-५१-११॥
verses.transliteration: na atikrāntam muniśreṣṭha yat kartavyam kṛtam mayā ।saṁgatā muninā patnī bhārgaveṇa iva reṇukā ॥1-51-11॥

translations.english: O Best of ascetics (Satananda) All that is required to be done has been done and nothing was omitted. Ahalya was united with sage Gautama like Renuka with Jamadagni.

verses.sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ।शतानंदो महातेजा रामम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-५१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ।śatānaṁdo mahātejā rāmam vacanam abravīt ॥1-51-12॥

translations.english: Having heard Viswamitra the highly brilliant Satananda said to Rama:
translations.hindi: और महाभागा अहल्या को तारिए जिससे बह देवरूपिणी हो ज्ञाय | श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण ने, विश्वामित्र जी के ये वचन । सुन

verses.sloka: स्वागतम् ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो असि राघव ।विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य महर्षिम् अपराजितम् ॥१-५१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: svāgatam te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto asi rāghava ।viśvāmitram puraskṛtya maharṣim aparājitam ॥1-51-13॥

translations.english: "O Best of men O Son of the Raghus you are fortunate to have come here following the invincible maharshi Viswamitra. Welcome to you.

verses.sloka: अचिन्त्य कर्मा तपसा ब्रह्मर्षिः अमित प्रभः ।विश्वामित्रो महातेजा - वेद्म्य - वेत्सि एनम् परमाम् गतिम् ॥१-५१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: acintya karmā tapasā brahmarṣiḥ amita prabhaḥ ।viśvāmitro mahātejā - vedmya - vetsi enam paramām gatim ॥1-51-14॥

translations.english: Highly lustrous Viswamitra has performed deeds which defy all imagination. By his austerities, he became Brahmarshi and possesses unparalleled radiance. Know him to be the supreme resort.
translations.hindi: जाकर देखा कि, अहल्या तप के ते क हेल्या तप के तेज से प्रकाशित हो रही लोकैरपि समागम्य हुर्निरीच्यां सुरासुरैः । EE निर्मितां धात्रा दिव्यां पायामयीमिव

verses.sloka: न अस्ति धन्यतरो राम त्वत्तो अन्यो भुवि कश्चन ।गोप्ता कुशिक पुत्रः ते येन तप्तम् महत् तपः ॥१-५१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: na asti dhanyataro rāma tvatto anyo bhuvi kaścana ।goptā kuśika putraḥ te yena taptam mahat tapaḥ ॥1-51-15॥

translations.english: Rama Son of Kushika (Viswamitra) who has performed great austerities is your protector. Therefore, there is none on this earth more fortunate than you.
translations.hindi: र कोहरे (कुद्दासे) से छिपी हुई पूर्णमासी के चन्द्रमा की स्वच्छ चाँदनी की परह, अथवा जल में पड़े हुए सूर्य के प्रतिबिम्ब के दुरा- धर्ष प्रकाश की तरह, वह 'दीप्रिधती देख पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: श्रूयताम् च अभिधास्यामि कौशिकस्य महात्मनः ।यथा बलम् यथा तत्त्वम् तत् मे निगदतः शृणु ॥१-५१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyatām ca abhidhāsyāmi kauśikasya mahātmanaḥ ।yathā balam yathā tattvam tat me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥1-51-16॥

translations.english: I shall tell you about the power and achievement of the magnanimous son of Kushika Viswamitra. Listen
translations.hindi: र अहल्या ने अर्ध्ये पाचादि से भली भाँति उनका आतिथ्य किया । दोनों राजकुमारों ने भी शाखां में वर्णित विधिविधान के साथ किए गए उसके आतिथ्य को ग्रहण किया

verses.sloka: राजा अभूत् एष धर्मात्मा दीर्घ कालम् अरिन्दमः ।धर्मज्ञः कृत विद्यः च प्रजानाम् च हिते रतः ॥१-५१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: rājā abhūt eṣa dharmātmā dīrgha kālam arindamaḥ ।dharmajñaḥ kṛta vidyaḥ ca prajānām ca hite rataḥ ॥1-51-17॥

translations.english: This righteousminded sage, subduer of enemies, knower of dharma knowledgeable in all branches of learning, devoted to the welfare of his subjects ruled as a king for long.
translations.hindi: दु र खुर न जलती हुई आग की लपट की तरह, वह ल्या गौतम ऋषि के शाप से किसी को नहीं दिखलाई पड़ती त्रयाणासपि लोकानां यात्रद्रामस्य दर्शनम्‌ । सल्या तेषां दर्शममागता

verses.sloka: प्रजापति सुतः तु आसीत् कुशो नाम महीपतिः ।कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान् कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः ॥१-५१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpati sutaḥ tu āsīt kuśo nāma mahīpatiḥ ।kuśasya putro balavān kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ ॥1-51-18॥

translations.english: There was a king named Kusa who was the son of Brahma. His son was Kusanabha who was supremely righteous and strong.

verses.sloka: कुशनाभ सुतः तु आसीत् गाधिः इति एव विश्रुतः ।गाधेः पुत्रो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-५१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: kuśanābha sutaḥ tu āsīt gādhiḥ iti eva viśrutaḥ ।gādheḥ putro mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-51-19॥

translations.english: Wellknown Gadhi was the son of Kusanabha. Highly lustrous and mighty ascetic Viswamitra is the son of Gadhi.

verses.sloka: विश्वमित्रो महातेजाः पालयामास मेदिनीम् ।बहु वर्ष सहस्राणि राजा राज्यम् अकारयत् ॥१-५१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: viśvamitro mahātejāḥ pālayāmāsa medinīm ।bahu varṣa sahasrāṇi rājā rājyam akārayat ॥1-51-20॥

translations.english: Highly lustrous Viswamitra ruled the earth. As a king he ruled over his kingdom for thousands of years.
translations.hindi: न उस समय आकाश से फूलों की वर्षा हुई देवता ने नगाडे बजाए। गन्धर्व और अप्सराए गाने ओर नाचने गी

verses.sloka: कदाचित् तु महातेजा योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम् ।अक्षौहिणी परिवृतः परिचक्राम मेदिनीम् ॥१-५१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: kadācit tu mahātejā yojayitvā varūthinīm ।akṣauhiṇī parivṛtaḥ paricakrāma medinīm ॥1-51-21॥

translations.english: Once that highly lustrous Viswamitra having assembled his army of the magnitude of akshauhini went round the earth.
translations.hindi: विश्ुंद्धना एए १ __-_- _------:य २ कर्मणा--प्रकारेण (गो० ) म!गमनं विदित्वा समागत १ विधिदृष्टेन--शाख्रहष्टेन | > ३ गौतमस्य वशानुगामित्यनेन गोदमस्तदा रा इत्यवगम्यते | [ गो० ] देवतागण अहल्या की प्रशंसा करने लगे । गौतम जी ( अपने तपःप्रभाव से ) श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का आना जान अपने आश्रम में पहुँचे और वहाँ पूवं के समान धारण किए हुए अहल्या को पाकर प्रसन्‍न हुए

verses.sloka: नगराणि च राष्ट्रानि सरितः च तथा गिरीन् ।आश्रमान् क्रमशो राजा विचरन् आजगाम ह ॥१-५१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: nagarāṇi ca rāṣṭrāni saritaḥ ca tathā girīn ।āśramān kramaśo rājā vicaran ājagāma ha ॥1-51-22॥

translations.english: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. That hermitage afounded in a variety of trees, species of animals, siddhas, charanas, devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinnaras, multitudes of birds and resting deer. It was inhabited by brahmarshis and devarishis, by sages who had attained perfection through austerities, by those resembling fire in brightness, by the magnanimous and the selfrestrained, by those who had conquered anger and controlled their senses, who was devoted to prayers and offerings of libations. Some of them subsisted on water, some on air. Some lived on fallen leaves, some on fruits and roots. The hermitage looked bedecked with valakhilyas (born from Vala of Brahma ) and vaikhanasas (born from the nails of Brahma).
translations.hindi: अहल्या सहित महातेजस्त्रो गौतम ऋि ने प्रसन्न हो श्रीराम का भली भाँति पूजन किया आर फिर वे उसी आश्रम में तप करने लगे

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठस्य आश्रम पदम् नाना पुष्प लता द्रुमम् ।नाना मृग गण आकीर्णम् सिद्ध चारण सेवितम् ॥१-५१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya āśrama padam nānā puṣpa latā drumam ।nānā mṛga gaṇa ākīrṇam siddha cāraṇa sevitam ॥1-51-23॥

translations.english: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. That hermitage afounded in a variety of trees, species of animals, siddhas, charanas, devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinnaras, multitudes of birds and resting deer. It was inhabited by brahmarshis and devarishis, by sages who had attained perfection through austerities, by those resembling fire in brightness, by the magnanimous and the selfrestrained, by those who had conquered anger and controlled their senses, who was devoted to prayers and offerings of libations. Some of them subsisted on water, some on air. Some lived on fallen leaves, some on fruits and roots. The hermitage looked bedecked with valakhilyas (born from Vala of Brahma ) and vaikhanasas (born from the nails of Brahma).

verses.sloka: देव दानव गन्धर्वैः किन्नरैः उपशोभितम् ।प्रशांत हरिण आकीर्णम् द्विज संघ निषेवितम् ॥१-५१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: deva dānava gandharvaiḥ kinnaraiḥ upaśobhitam ।praśāṁta hariṇa ākīrṇam dvija saṁgha niṣevitam ॥1-51-24॥

translations.english: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. That hermitage afounded in a variety of trees, species of animals, siddhas, charanas, devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinnaras, multitudes of birds and resting deer. verses.sloka: ब्रह्म ऋषि गण संकीर्णम् देव ऋषि गण सेवितम् ।तपः चरण संसिद्धैः अग्नि कल्पैः महात्मभिः ॥१-५१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: brahma ṛṣi gaṇa saṁkīrṇam deva ṛṣi gaṇa sevitam ।tapaḥ caraṇa saṁsiddhaiḥ agni kalpaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ ॥1-51-25॥

translations.english: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. verses.sloka: सततम् संकुलम् श्रीमत् ब्रह्म कल्पैः महात्मभिः ।अब् भक्षैः वायु भक्षैः च शीर्ण पर्ण अशनैः तथा ॥१-५१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: satatam saṁkulam śrīmat brahma kalpaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ ।ab bhakṣaiḥ vāyu bhakṣaiḥ ca śīrṇa parṇa aśanaiḥ tathā ॥1-51-26॥

verses.sloka: फलमूलाशनैर्दान्तैर्जितदोषैर्जितेन्द्रियैः - यद्वा -फल मूल अशनैः दान्तैः जित दोषैः जित इन्द्रियैः ।ऋषिभिः वालखिल्यैः च जप होम परायणैः ॥१-५१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāśanairdāntairjitadoṣairjitendriyaiḥ - yadvā -phala mūla aśanaiḥ dāntaiḥ jita doṣaiḥ jita indriyaiḥ ।ṛṣibhiḥ vālakhilyaiḥ ca japa homa parāyaṇaiḥ ॥1-51-27॥

verses.sloka: अन्यैः वैखानसैः चैव समंतात् उपशोभितम् ।वसिष्ठस्य आश्रम पदम् ब्रह्म लोकम् इव अपरम् ।ददर्श जयताम् श्रेष्ठ विश्वामित्रो महाबलः ॥१-५१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: anyaiḥ vaikhānasaiḥ caiva samaṁtāt upaśobhitam ।vasiṣṭhasya āśrama padam brahma lokam iva aparam ।dadarśa jayatām śreṣṭha viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ ॥1-51-28॥

translations.english: Highly powerful Viswamitra, foremost among the conquerors, (thus) saw the hermitage of Vasishta which looked like another Brahmaloka. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्ग:। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
